problem: SHAE-5 found that this repository's Codex gate had the same defects as the relay. F-1 (medium): a Codex review WITH findings publishes its completion receipt as a pull-request review, but scripts/review-budget.mjs and scripts/promote-reviewed-pr.mjs only read issue comments, so the repair-review cycle stalls at previous_review_pending. F-2 (low): a valid CODEX_REVIEW_REQUEST_TOKEN that belongs to the wrong GitHub user returned skipped_wrong_requester and the run was green. F-3 (low-medium): the readiness workflow used one repo-wide concurrency group, so a pending run for one PR could be dropped when another PR's run queued.
solution: F-1: review-budget.mjs gains codexReceipt and classifyCodexReview. A receipt is accepted from the Codex bot as an issue comment (clean review) or a submitted PR review (review with findings), only if commit_id equals the exact head and the body has the receipt marker and a Reviewed commit prefix of that head. The request script reads GET /pulls/{n}/reviews after a prior request exists (incomplete scans fail closed) and the ready gate promotes only a clean classification. Budget caps, P0 stop, CI and hold rules are unchanged. F-2: a wrong-owner token now throws codex_request_wrong_requester; the CLI exits 1 with a fixed ::error annotation that never prints a login or token, posts nothing and leaves the PR a draft. F-3: the PR-creation job was already per branch (agent-pr-<branch>); the readiness gate group is now per PR for a Codex comment and one shared group for sweeps, and the sparse checkout adds scripts/review-budget.mjs, which the gate now imports. Docs updated.

npm run lint and npm run format:check: passed (prettier applied to changed scripts, tests, docs and this file)

node --test request-codex-review, review-budget, promote-reviewed-pr, review-gate-trigger and sync-linear-lifecycle test files: 71 passed, 0 failed. Baseline on main for the first four files was 33 passed.

New coverage: both receipt shapes; forged or lookalike author, stale SHA, PENDING/DISMISSED, incomplete receipts, duplicates, skipped/failed CI, unreadable or over-long review list, P3 budget exhaustion with PR-review receipts, wrong-owner token incl. exit code, and event replay through GitHub's one-running/one-pending queue rule.
Changed on purpose: the wrong-requester test now expects the F-2 failure instead of a skip. No other existing assertion was loosened.

Mutation checks: 13 deliberate regressions (author, commit_id, review state, receipt commit, findings-as-clean, old F-1/F-2 behavior, ignoring reviews, shared group, missing sparse checkout) each made a named test fail; files restored.

NOT run: GitHub Actions itself and actionlint (the workflow edit was validated by YAML parsing and the queue model only; it takes effect after merge), a live Codex review with findings, and the live pilot.
